history.user: Landed at Changi at last. My suitcase came off the belt with a wheel missing and I am too wrung out to queue at the desk about it.
history.assistant: A long haul and a three-wheeled suitcase. The desk can wait until you have slept.

history.user: Back in my own flat. The basil on the windowsill has collapsed completely but the spider plant looks smug.
history.assistant: One casualty and one survivor. The spider plant always wins.

history.user: The last of the guests from Dad's seventieth have just gone. I have washed something like forty glasses and I am sitting in the kitchen next to an empty cake stand.
history.assistant: Forty glasses and a bare cake stand. That is the sign of a good party.

history.user: Gone twelve now. My brother Callum stayed behind with the end of the port and we have dragged two chairs out onto the patio.
history.assistant: Port on the patio after everyone has left sounds like the best part of the evening.

history.user: He has just told me he is taking the job in Aberdeen in the new year. I was not ready for how much that would sting.
history.assistant: News like that can be said very lightly and still land heavily.

history.user: He has gone up to bed. I am stacking the folding chairs in the hall, slowly, one at a time.
history.assistant: Slowly sounds right. No one is timing you.

history.user: Found one last sausage roll under a sheet of foil and ate it cold, standing over the bin.
history.assistant: The final sausage roll belongs to whoever does the clearing up.

history.user: Still up. I keep wondering who is going to do Sunday lunch with Dad once Callum has moved.
history.assistant: That is a hard gap to picture filled by anyone else.

history.user: Oh, the clocks have just gone back. The cooker says quarter past one all over again, so I have been handed this hour twice.
history.assistant: A second go at the same hour. Use it however you like.

history.user: Right, that is me. Lights off.

steps.text: What did I tell you on Saturday night before midnight, and what came once it was past midnight?
Which did I mention first, the last sausage roll or the clocks going back?
And what day did my flight get in on that trip?
